Every gate script finds <ROOT> from where it sits (anywhere under <ROOT>\.MD\scripts) or from the PIPELINE_ROOT environment variable, and every other file through <ROOT>\.MD\resolvers\resolve.py; this file records what was chosen so a person or an agent can read it. Secrets never go here - the Nexus key is the NEXUS_APIKEY environment variable.
